# Direction: Fixture App

<!-- a comment with {{placeholder}} that must be ignored -->

## 1. Product truth

- Who and when: a collector at the shelf, nightly, ten minutes
- The moment that matters: choosing what to wear tomorrow
- Should feel: calm, tactile, a little ceremonial
- Must never feel: like a dashboard of stat tiles
- Owner notes so far: none yet, this is a new app

## 2. Content shape

| Object | What it really is | Drawn as | Not as |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fragrance | a scent with an accord | accord strip | stat tile |
| Note | an ingredient | stamped label | chip |
| Wear | a dated event | line in a diary | log row |

## 3. The world

| Artifact | Mechanism to take | Where it lands in the UI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Perfumer organ | scents ordered by volatility | shelf order on Collection |
| Apothecary label | name over a ruled line | row titles |
| Swatch card | sample beside the name | detail header |

Software precedents:
- Letterboxd: keep the diary rhythm, break the star glyphs

## 4. Thesis

Thesis: the eye goes to the accord strip because it is the only colour, everything else steps back
Tension: warm but exact: exact wins on numbers
Signature: the accord strip on every shelf row, born from how a perfume is built
Principles:
1. Colour only ever means scent family here
2. Names are set larger than any number on screen
3. One saturated thing per screen, never two

## 5. Directions

### A. Name A
- Thesis: a clear one sentence thesis for A
- Structure: sidebar and detail with dense rows
- Type: serif headings with a mono body
- Colour: one saturated accent on warm paper
- Material: flat paper with a hard edge
- Signature: the accord strip across the shelf

## 6. System

### Layout
Sidebar of shelves with a detail pane, dense rows, primary action at the top right of the detail pane. Sidebar of shelves with a detail pane, dense rows, primary action at the top right of the detail pane. 

### Type
Serif headings at 28 and 20, mono body at 14, numerals tabular, sentence case everywhere. Serif headings at 28 and 20, mono body at 14, numerals tabular, sentence case everywhere. 

### Colour
Warm paper ground, one accent per scent family, dark mode inverts the paper to ink. Warm paper ground, one accent per scent family, dark mode inverts the paper to ink. 

### Material and shape
Flat paper surfaces, two pixel hard edge, radius 4 on controls and none on rows. Flat paper surfaces, two pixel hard edge, radius 4 on controls and none on rows. 

### Motion
Press sinks two pixels in 80ms, selection slides the strip in 160ms, nothing bounces. Press sinks two pixels in 80ms, selection slides the strip in 160ms, nothing bounces. 

### Words
Short nouns for labels, the product says wear and shelf, empty states name the next action. Short nouns for labels, the product says wear and shelf, empty states name the next action. 

### Craft
Everything aligns to the strip edge, spacing steps 4 8 16 24, focus is a two pixel ink ring. Everything aligns to the strip edge, spacing steps 4 8 16 24, focus is a two pixel ink ring.
